summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing a press release on commercial progress, not a special situation. The release reports CyPath Lung test sales rose more than 100% through Q3 2026 versus Q3 2025, with ordering physicians up 89% and repeat-user volume up 48%; 1,620 tests were delivered through Q3 2026 versus 775 a year earlier. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The event is ordinary operational disclosure; there is no deal, no arbitrage angle, and no special-situations catalyst to watch.
